Time has returned to its form at the creation of heavens and earth: the year has twelve months, four sacred, Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Muharram in succession, and Mudar's Rajab.
The year is twelve months, four of them sacred: Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Muharram in succession, and Rajab between Jumada and Sha'ban.
On the day of Nahr the Prophet names the four sacred months, declares blood, property and honour sacred, forbids killing one another, and has those present inform the absent.
On the Day of Nahr the Prophet said four of the twelve months are sacred, and that lives, property and honour are as sacred as that day, town and month.
